parameters.jsCode:
// Style guides (Drive, read via the Google Drive connector on 22 Oct 2026): the n8n Google credential gets 403 on these docs,
// so the text is kept here. Export guides is DISABLED and passes these items through as $json.data.
// Re-read the guides and update this node when a guide is edited.
const G = {
"de": "German Style Guide – Global (DRAFT v2, Drive, read 22.10.26). Glossary takes precedence.
Spelling: Neue Deutsche Rechtschreibung, ß (not Swiss ss). Abbreviations: z. B., d. h., Nr., Std., Min., Sek.
Tone: short sentences instead of nested ones.
Register: address customers with "du" everywhere; never "Sie", not even in single sentences. du/dir/dich/dein lowercase except at sentence start.
Inclusiveness: generic masculine; no gender star, colon, Binnen-I or double naming.
Buttons and labels: infinitive ("Passwort zurücksetzen", "QR-Code herunterladen"). Full CTA sentences, instructions and MARKETING TEXTS: du-imperative ("Verwalte dein Abonnement").
Capitalization: standard German (nouns capitalized); never copy English title case in headings, buttons or UI names.
Punctuation: short labels, buttons and headings have no final period; full sentences end with a period. Quotes „…“ only. Exclamation marks sparingly. Write "und" instead of "&".
Terminology: "Abonnement"; "Konto" not "Account"; "E-Mail"; keep English only if established in German (Dashboard, Support, Upload, Download), otherwise translate ("Einstellungen", "Anmelden"). Brand and product names unchanged and not inflected: Chat AI (and Chatbot Online).
Numbers: 1.000,50; percent "10 %"; prices "10 €"; dates "3. März 2025"; 24-hour time.",
"es": "Spanish Style Guide – Global (DRAFT v2, Drive, read 22.10.26). Glossary takes precedence.
Follow RAE/Fundéu. Abbreviations: p. ej. or ej., etc., n.º, h, min, s.
Tone: direct, professional-sounding but easy to understand; we are selling a service, so engaging, natural and appealing. Informal tone, colloquial expressions appropriate, active voice.
Register: always informal "tú".
Consistency: keep terminology consistent with past translations (TM).
Inclusiveness: prefer neutral phrasing ("Te damos la bienvenida" instead of "Bienvenido/a"); no @, x or -e endings.
Buttons: infinitive (Descargar, Iniciar sesión). Full CTAs and instructions: tú imperative (Regístrate, Contáctanos).
Capitalization: sentence case, never English title case.
Punctuation: always opening ¿ and ¡. Quotes: straight "…" (follow TM). Exclamation marks sparingly. Write "y" instead of "&".
Numbers: decimal comma (9,99), thousands period (10.000). Percent "5 %". Currency "29,99 €". 24-hour time.
PRODUCT SECTION "UniCopy and AI Chat" (takes precedence): audience is potential clients, both businesses and individuals; always informal "tú".",
"fr": "French Style Guide – Global (DRAFT v2, Drive, read 22.10.26). Glossary takes precedence. ° below = non-breaking space (U+00A0).
Abbreviations: 1er, 1re, 2e, p. ex., etc., Go, h, min, s.
Tone: clear and concise; never literal, always idiomatic. Exclamation points only occasionally.
Register: "vous".
Inclusiveness: gender-neutral (epicene words/phrasings); feminine mark in parentheses only when unavoidable, e.g. facturé(e).
Headers: imperative ("Sélectionnez un mode de paiement"). Buttons: infinitive ("Nous contacter").
Syntax: avoid long sentences, stacked adjectives and repetitions; use fewer possessives than English (definite article instead).
Capitalization: far fewer capitals than English – only first word and proper nouns; accented capitals (À, É).
Non-breaking space mandatory before : ; ? ! and inside « » ; between number and unit/currency (4°semaines, 1,99°€); thousands separator is a non-breaking space (9°999,99).
Punctuation follows the source; headlines have no period. Quotes « … ». Straight apostrophes ('). Write "et" instead of "&".
Numbers: in marketing, follow the EN source for numerals. Decimal comma. 24-hour time "22°h°30".",
"it": "Italian Style Guide – Global (DRAFT v2, Drive, read 22.10.26). Glossary takes precedence.
Abbreviations: min., sec., es., ecc., n.
Tone: friendly, inclusive, respectful and optimistic. Keep copy as brief as possible, ideally close to the source character count or shorter.
Register: informal "tu".
Gender: expressions valid for both genders ("ti diamo il benvenuto"); if impossible, "informato/a".
CTAs: imperative ("Registrati ora"). Buttons: ALSO imperative ("Accedi").
Syntax: avoid long sentences, stacked adjectives, repetitions.
Capitalization: È (never E'); headlines in sentence case ("Ottieni subito l'accesso").
Punctuation: quotes “…”; straight apostrophe ('); exclamation marks sparingly; "e" instead of "&". Never translate URLs.
Numbers: decimal comma, thousands period (10.000); percent without space "5%"; currency "29,99 €"; time "alle 21:00".",
"nl": "Dutch Style Guide – Global (DRAFT v2, Drive, read 22.10.26). Glossary takes precedence.
Spelling: Van Dale / Woordenlijst. Abbreviations: bijv., d.w.z., enz., nr., u, min, sec.
Tone: informal "je/jij", warm, welcoming, engaging, informal but still professional. Paraphrasing permitted for better style if register and meaning are kept.
Inclusiveness: gender-neutral; address the user with "je" rather than gendered nouns.
CTAs: imperative ("Klik nu hier"). Buttons: infinitive (Downloaden, Inloggen, Registreren), unless the context makes it a CTA.
Capitalization: sentence case, never English title case.
Punctuation: straight double quotes "…"; straight apostrophe; no space before ? ! : ;; exclamation marks sparingly; "en" instead of "&".
Numbers: decimal comma, thousands period (10.000); percent "5%"; currency "€ 29,99"; time "21.00 uur".",
"pt": "Portuguese (Brazil) Style Guide – Global (DRAFT v2, Drive, read 22.10.26). Glossary takes precedence.
Tone: confident and helpful; voice formal but friendly.
Register: "você" (mostly implicit) with 3rd-person verb forms ("Forneça detalhes sobre seu restaurante").
Gender: neutral and natural; avoid articles in parentheses like do(a).
Buttons: infinitive (Baixar, Iniciar sessão, Criar conta). Full CTAs and instructions: imperative (Entre em contato).
Capitalization: do NOT follow English capitalization – only the first word of headers, titles and buttons; no capitals for days, months, language names; DO capitalize names of policies/terms/resources (Política de Privacidade, Termos de Uso, Central de Ajuda).
Punctuation: curly quotes “…”; exclamation marks sparingly; "e" instead of "&".
Numbers: decimal comma, thousands dot (2.350); "mil" for thousand, "mi" for million, "bi" for billion; in full texts numbers 1–10 in words; percent "5%"; currency "R$ 1,10"; time "23h30"; abbreviation for seconds "s"."
};
const cfg = $('Config').first().json;
return cfg.langs.filter(function (iso) { return G[iso]; }).map(function (iso) { return { json: { iso: iso, data: G[iso] } }; });

const g = $('Gate').all().map(function (i) { return i.json; });
return [{ json: { results: $input.all().map(function (r, i) { const b = r.json.body || {}; return { iso: (g[i] || {}).iso, sent: (g[i] || {}).n, status: r.json.statusCode, written: (b.keys || []).length, errors: b.errors || b.error || null }; }) } }];
